hyperedges.label: TTS Latency Optimization Stack
hyperedges.description: Pool of 3 synthesizers, MP3 format, clause splitting, and concurrent queue sender all work together to minimize TTS contribution to end-to-end latency

hyperedges.label: STT Latency Optimization Stack
hyperedges.description: Persistent httpx singleton, parallel asyncio.gather with session fetch, and in-place cache update together reduce STT contribution from 660–3726ms to 500–620ms stable

hyperedges.label: Voice Pipeline Critical Path Components
hyperedges.description: All five components participate sequentially (with internal parallelism) in the latency-critical path from speech_end to first audio playback

hyperedges.label: DIY vs Retell Build-vs-Buy Decision
hyperedges.description: The decision to maintain a DIY voice pipeline over adopting Retell AI is grounded in cost (4-5x cheaper), voice differentiator (Neerja), and full pipeline control — weighed against Retell's ~700ms latency advantage

hyperedges.description: Persistent httpx singleton, parallel asyncio.gather with session fetch, and in-place cache update together reduce STT contribution from 660–3726ms to 500–620ms stable

hyperedges.label: Voice Pipeline Critical Path Components
hyperedges.description: All five components participate sequentially (with internal parallelism) in the latency-critical path from speech_end to first audio playback

hyperedges.label: DIY vs Retell Build-vs-Buy Decision
hyperedges.description: The decision to maintain a DIY voice pipeline over adopting Retell AI is grounded in cost (4-5x cheaper), voice differentiator (Neerja), and full pipeline control — weighed against Retell's ~700ms latency advantage
